description.en: Production-ready animation and gesture library for React and modern JavaScript.
description.zh: 前身为 Framer Motion，现代 Web 与 React 动效手势引擎的事实标准。

content.en: Motion (formerly Framer Motion) is the production-ready animation engine powering modern web aesthetics. Created by Matt Perry, Motion combines declarative syntax, physics-based springs, multi-touch gestures, and layout morphing with buttery 60fps performance across React and vanilla JavaScript.
content.zh: Motion（前身为享誉业界的 Framer Motion）是现代前端动效领域的绝对事实标准。由 Matt Perry 开发，全库将声明式 API、真实的弹簧阻尼力学模拟、复杂手势识别与连续布局形变融为一体，为整个现代 Web 与设计工程师生态提供了不可或缺的动力学基础设施。
